title: Wheeler's It from Bit paper cites Observer Mechanics

tellings.quote: Actually know Wheeler cited my work in his his it from bit paper

plain: The researcher Don Hoffman tells Michels that the physicist John Wheeler cited Hoffman's own work in his 1989 paper known as "It from Bit". The work Wheeler cited, Hoffman says, was Observer Mechanics, a theory about observers that Hoffman developed with Bruce Bennett and Chaitan Posh. Hoffman offers this as a sign that a major physicist took his ideas about the observer seriously.
